column1: The Cistern Wyrm — a conger the length of a street living in the cistern network under every district. Arena: the chapel's god-pool until tide 12; after that any of the 12 grates, so the city is the arena.

HP 15,000 (x1.08 per tide); armor: only the head is exposed above a grate; weak point: the gills, exposed when it surfaces fully (Surface strike, 2 s after) and when the god-pool trap strands it (6 s).

Phase 1 (100-60%): Surface strike from the god-pool and the two chapel grates (G11, G12); Drag below (a diver pulled into the drains: teammates have 6 s to deal 200 to the gills at the grate). It never leaves the summit in phase 1.

Phase 2 (60-30%): it uses every grate in the current district and the district below it (blood flows downhill, and so does it); Coil loops a street and blocks it 4 s; congers pour from the other grates.

Phase 3 (30-0%): Flood: every grate in the district surges (slow 30%, blood doubled), which calls the great white over the wall onto whatever is bleeding; it surfaces fully to hunt the streets and can be fought like a normal beast, but its blood in the aqueduct brings the great white to it as well as to you.

Arena rules: the god-pool trap (1,000) drains the pool and strands it for 6 s if it's home; netting three of a district's grates forces it to surface at the fourth (predictable); ichor-scented streets (dead Lost Ones) keep it below for 60 s.
Kill reward: 1,500 base scrip x tide, a Locker weapon each, and the lighthouse key. It reforms in the god-pool after 6 minutes at 50% HP.
